title: Hierarchy
statementMd:
Nick's company employed $*n*$ people. Now Nick needs to build a tree hierarchy of «supervisor-surbodinate» relations in the company (this is to say that each employee, except one, has exactly one supervisor). There are $*m*$ applications written in the following form: «employee $*a*_{*i*}$ is ready to become a supervisor of employee $*b*_{*i*}$ at extra cost $*c*_{*i*}$». The qualification $*q*_{*j*}$ of each employee is known, and for each application the following is true: $*q*_{*a*_{*i*}} > *q*_{*b*_{*i*}}$.

Would you help Nick calculate the minimum cost of such a hierarchy, or find out that it is impossible to build it.

## Input

The first input line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$) — amount of employees in the company. The following line contains $*n*$ space-separated numbers $*q*_{*j*}$ ($0 ≤ *q*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{6}$)— the employees' qualifications. The following line contains number $*m*$ ($0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10000$) — amount of received applications. The following $*m*$ lines contain the applications themselves, each of them in the form of three space-separated numbers: $*a*_{*i*}$, $*b*_{*i*}$ and $*c*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$). Different applications can be similar, i.e. they can come from one and the same employee who offered to become a supervisor of the same person but at a different cost. For each application $*q*_{*a*_{*i*}} > *q*_{*b*_{*i*}}$.

## Output

Output the only line — the minimum cost of building such a hierarchy, or `-1` if it is impossible to build it.

## Note

In the first sample one of the possible ways for building a hierarchy is to take applications with indexes 1, 2 and 4, which give 11 as the minimum total cost. In the second sample it is impossible to build the required hierarchy, so the answer is `-1`.
statementZhMd:
Nick 的公司雇用了 $*n*$ 名员工。现在 Nick 需要在公司中建立一棵“上司-下属”关系树（也就是说，除了其中一人外，每名员工都恰好有一名上司）。目前有 $*m*$ 份申请，格式如下：“员工 $*a*_{*i*}$ 愿意额外花费 $*c*_{*i*}$ 成为员工 $*b*_{*i*}$ 的上司”。已知每名员工的资质为 $*q*_{*j*}$，并且对于每份申请，都满足：$*q*_{*a*_{*i*}} > *q*_{*b*_{*i*}}$。

请你帮助 Nick 计算建立这样一棵层级关系树所需的最小费用，或者判断无法建立这样的层级关系树。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$），表示公司中的员工数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的数 $*q*_{*j*}$（$0 ≤ *q*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{6}$），表示每名员工的资质。

第三行包含一个整数 $*m*$（$0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10000$），表示收到的申请数。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行每行包含一份申请，格式为三个以空格分隔的数：$*a*_{*i*}$、$*b*_{*i*}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）。不同的申请可能相同，也就是说，同一名员工可能申请以不同的费用成为同一个人的上司。对于每份申请，都满足 $*q*_{*a*_{*i*}} > *q*_{*b*_{*i*}}$。

## 输出格式

输出一行：建立这样的层级关系树所需的最小费用；如果无法建立，则输出 `-1`。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一种建立层级关系树的方法是选择编号为 1、2 和 4 的申请，此时最小总费用为 11。在第二个样例中，无法建立所要求的层级关系树，因此答案为 `-1`。
